programme.title: Chatroom Japan
programme.desc: A Chinese woman living in Japan holds gatherings for Chinese children with the goal of boosting their confidence in their international background.

programme.title: Impacts: Climates Change the World
programme.desc: Rising CO2 emissions are causing a phenomenon called 'ocean acidification', which severely impacts marine life and could further accelerate global warming. We examine its effects on the environment.

programme.title: Design Museum Japan
programme.desc: Ehime / Nagazumi Takashi (musician) Nagazumi visits a town with a great number of trowel reliefs, and observes that the things that truly last are the ones that carry the creator's intention.

programme.title: The Factory Wonders
programme.desc: This time, we explore a Nanbu ironware factory blending traditional moulds and casting techniques with modern design. See masterful skills and a president's passion for ironware re-imagined for today.

programme.title: Hagi
programme.desc: Hagi, a World Heritage site of ten described as an 'open-air museum,' is lined with merchant and samurai houses and retains much of its 17th-century townscape. Soak in the atmosphere, in time-lapse.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: The Seasons of Yamato
programme.desc: A series of poetic videos by Koichi Hozan, a videographer living in Nara, in collaboration with a pianist, Mine Kawakami, for which she plays exclusive pieces, makes you experience each seasons.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
